title: Golden Boat Rentals and Boat Club
specs: Boats suitable for tubing and water skiing
blurb: Guests rent luxury pontoon boats with powerful motors and amenities like Bluetooth stereos, mood lighting, and spacious layouts. Boats accommodate from 10 to 16 passengers and are suitable for tubing, water skiing, and cruising. Optional LilyPad floating mats and tubing equipment are available for additional fees.
highlights: Boats suitable for tubing and water skiing

quotes.author: Guy G. via Google
quotes.text: Golden Boat Rentals is very professional and terrific to work with. The boat was in great shape! Much better than other companies we have used in the past. We will definitely be back next summer!

quotes.author: Sara W. via Google
quotes.text: It was a seamless experience and even let us borrow a speaker and gave us free ice to use in our cooler. We will definitely be renting from them again! Such a great time and amazing/clean boat.

quotes.author: Brittany E. via Facebook
quotes.text: We really enjoyed our boat day around Okauchee Lake! Golden Boat rentals had quite a few boats to rent and we loved the pontoon we had. They were super helpful during our trip!

quotes.author: Rafael C. via Facebook
quotes.text: Great experience and service. They were able to accommodate to our needs specially to my mom since she’s on a wheelchair. Stephan was very professional and attentive.

quotes.author: Stift via Tripadvisor
quotes.text: Had a great Time! Boats are clean, staff is helpful and friendly. Effortless check in! Thank you
